questions.text: First off, please think about the last five years: In general, do you think things are going in the right direction, or are they going in the wrong direction in Africa?
questions.label: African Continent Direction

questions.text: Which of the following adjectives would you use to describe how you feel about the future of your country?
questions.label: Optimism and Excitement Towards Future

questions.text: Which of the following events or developments that took place in the last 5 years in your view has had the biggest impact on Africa?
questions.label: Most Impactful Event of Last 5 years

questions.text: Now thinking about the next 5 years, which of the following, if any, are the most important things necessary for the AFRICAN CONTINENT to progress and move forward? Please choose up to two.
questions.label: Most Important things for Africa to progress

questions.text: Next, please tell me how concerned you are about each of the following issues...[Influence from Foreign Powers]
questions.label: Concern with the Influence from Foreign Powers

questions.text: Which statement is closer to your view? The world is becoming more divided and dangerous; The world is becoming more cooperative
questions.label: World Direction

questions.text: How much influence, if any at all, do you think each of the following countries or organisations have on your country?
questions.label: Influence of Foreign Countries

questions.text: And would you say the influence of each of the following countries or organisations on your country is positive or negative? [Among those that said they had influence]
questions.label: Positive Influence of Foreign Organisations
questions.baseText: Among those that said they had influence

questions.text: And would you say the influence of each of the following countries or organisations on your country is positive or negative? [The African Union]
questions.label: Positive Influence of Foreign Organisations: African Union
questions.baseText: Among those who said the African Union has influence

questions.text: And would you say the influence of each of the following countries or organisations on your country is positive or negative? [United Nations]
questions.label: Positive Influence of Foreign Organisations: United Nations
questions.baseText: Among those who said the United Nations has influence

questions.text: And would you say the influence of each of the following countries or organisations on your country is positive or negative? [World Trade Organisation]
questions.label: Positive Influence of Foreign Organisations: World Trade Organisation
questions.baseText: Among those who said the World Trade Organisation has influence

questions.text: And would you say the influence of each of the following countries or organisations on your country is positive or negative? [International Monetary Fund (IMF)]
questions.label: Positive Influence of Foreign Organisations: International Monetary Fund
questions.baseText: Among those who said the International Monetary Fund has influence

questions.text: And would you say the influence of each of the following countries or organisations on your country is positive or negative? [European Union]
questions.label: Positive Influence of Foreign Organisations: European Union
questions.baseText: Among those who said the European Union has influence

questions.text: And would you say the influence of each of the following countries or organisations on your country is positive or negative? [G20]
questions.label: Positive Influence of Foreign Organisations: G20
questions.baseText: Among those who said the G20 has influence

questions.text: And which of the following are more important for the UN to focus on in your country over the next five years?
questions.label: Areas of Focus for the UN in Your Country

questions.text: Which of the following statements do you agree with more?
questions.label: Systems of Government and Democracy

questions.text: Which of the following is more important to you?
questions.label: Systems of Government and Democracy

questions.text: When you think of an ‘African-style democracy’, which of the following matter most to you? Please select up to 3
questions.label: What makes up an African-Style Democracy?

questions.text: Overall, how safe do you feel in your country today?
questions.label: Feeling of Safety in Country Today

questions.text: Have you or someone in your immediate family been the victim of a crime in the past five years?
questions.label: Victim of a Crime in the Past Five Years

questions.text: Next, please tell me how concerned you are about each of the following issues... [Asylum and immigration]
questions.label: Concern about Asylum and Immigration

questions.text: How satisfied are you with your national government’s performance on each of the following? [Limiting illegal immigration into the country]
questions.label: Concern about Asylum and Immigration

questions.text: How confident are you in the government’s ability to deal with terrorism, insurgency, and armed conflict?
questions.label: Confidence in Government to Deal with Terrorism, Insurgency, and Armed Conflict

questions.text: How likely or unlikely are you to consider emigrating in the next three years?
questions.label: Likelihood to Emigrate

questions.text: If you were to emigrate, would you be leaving your country… [Among those ‘Very Likely’ / ‘Somewhat Likely’ / ‘Not so likely’ to emigrate in the next 3 years]
questions.label: Temporary vs Permanent Emigration
questions.baseText: Among those ‘Very Likely’ / ‘Somewhat Likely’ / ‘Not so likely’ to emigrate in the next 3 years

questions.text: Which of the following, if any, are the main reasons why you might consider emigrating to another country? Please select up to two
questions.label: Key Reasons to Emigrate
questions.baseText: Among those ‘Very likely’, Somewhat likely’ or ‘Not so likely’ to emigrate

questions.text: To what extend do you agree or disagree with the following questions? [In my country, everyone is equal before the law]
questions.label: Equality before the Law

questions.text: To what extend do you agree or disagree with the following questions? [I am treated fairly and with respect by the police and security services]
questions.label: Respectful Treatment by Police and Security Services

questions.text: To what extend do you agree or disagree with the following questions?
questions.label: My Country Should do More to Protect Ethnic Minorities

questions.text: Do you have regular, private access to the internet (i.e. workplace excluded)?
questions.label: Internet Access

questions.text: Generally speaking, how satisfied are you with the following public services and infrastructure in your country? [Telecommunications and Data Networks]
questions.label: Internet Access

questions.text: What is your opinion about the amount you pay for mobile data coverage?
questions.label: Mobile Data Coverage

questions.text: In a given month, would you say…?
questions.label: Mobile Data Coverage

questions.text: If your government proposed a ban on the use of social media by those aged 16 or under, would you…?
questions.label: Support for banning social media use for 16yrs and under

questions.text: Where do you get your news? Please select all that apply
questions.label: News Sources

questions.text: To the best of your knowledge, how often do you come across a fake news story?
questions.label: Encountering fake news

questions.text: To what extent do you agree or disagree with each of the following statements about fake news?
questions.label: Impact of Fake News on Society

questions.text: To what extent do you agree or disagree with each of the following statements about fake news? [Interest groups and organisations deliberately share fake news to push their agenda]
questions.label: Impact of Fake News on Society: Groups share it to push an agenda

questions.text: To what extent do you agree or disagree with each of the following statements about fake news? [I worry that misinformation or 'fake news' shared online could lead to real-world violence or conflict in my community]
questions.label: Impact of Fake News on Society: It could lead to real-world violence

questions.text: To what extent do you agree or disagree with each of the following statements about fake news? [Fake news is a serious problem in my community today]
questions.label: Impact of Fake News on Society: A serious problem in my community

questions.text: To what extent do you agree or disagree with each of the following statements about fake news? [I worry that artificial intelligence (AI) has made it easier to create and spread fake news]
questions.label: Impact of Fake News on Society: AI has made it easier to spread

questions.text: To what extent do you agree or disagree with each of the following statements about fake news? [Fake news has led to greater divide within my society]
questions.label: Impact of Fake News on Society: It has divided my society

questions.text: To what extent do you agree or disagree with each of the following statements about fake news? [Fake news impacts my ability to stay informed about issues that matter to me]
questions.label: Impact of Fake News on Society: It affects my ability to stay informed

questions.text: How would you describe your personal standard of living at present?
questions.label: Expected Quality of Life

questions.text: And do you think your personal standard of living over the next two years will get better, get worse, or do you think it will stay the same?
questions.label: Expected Quality of Life

questions.text: Which of the following is closer to your view? I will have a…
questions.label: Expected Quality of Life

questions.text: How satisfied are you with your national government’s performance on each of the following?
questions.label: Satisfaction with national government performance

questions.text: How satisfied are you with your national government’s performance on each of the following? [Maintaining political stability]
questions.label: Satisfaction with national government performance: Maintaining political stability

questions.text: How satisfied are you with your national government’s performance on each of the following? [Tackling government corruption]
questions.label: Satisfaction with national government performance: Tackling government corruption

questions.text: How satisfied are you with your national government’s performance on each of the following? [Addressing climate change and environmental degradation]
questions.label: Satisfaction with national government performance: Addressing climate change

questions.text: How satisfied are you with your national government’s performance on each of the following? [Limiting illegal immigration into the country]
questions.label: Satisfaction with national government performance: Limiting illegal immigration

questions.text: How satisfied are you with your national government’s performance on each of the following? [Reducing poverty]
questions.label: Satisfaction with national government performance: Reducing poverty

questions.text: How satisfied are you with your national government’s performance on each of the following? [Job creation and fighting unemployment]
questions.label: Satisfaction with national government performance: Job creation

questions.text: How satisfied are you with your national government’s performance on each of the following? [Tackling rising costs (e.g. inflation, food costs, fuel costs, etc.)]
questions.label: Satisfaction with national government performance: Tackling rising costs

questions.text: Next, please tell me how concerned you are about each of the following issues...
questions.label: Concern about Climate Change

questions.text: Which of the following is closer to your opinion? When addressing climate change, my government’s efforts should be…
questions.label: Government efforts when addressing climate change

questions.text: Which of the following should the government prioritise to help people in your country adapt to environmental changes? Please select up to three
questions.label: Government priorities to adapt to environmental changes

questions.text: Next, please tell me how concerned you are about each of the following issues... ?
questions.label: Concern with Environmental Challenges

questions.text: Next, please tell me how concerned you are about each of the following issues... ? [The amount of plastic waste]
questions.label: Concern with Environmental Challenges: The amount of plastic waste

questions.text: Next, please tell me how concerned you are about each of the following issues... ? [Water scarcity]
questions.label: Concern with Environmental Challenges: Water scarcity

questions.text: Next, please tell me how concerned you are about each of the following issues... ? [The unregulated use of natural resources such as wildlife, timber trees, fish or minerals]
questions.label: Concern with Environmental Challenges: Unregulated use of natural resources

questions.text: Generally speaking, how satisfied are you with the following public services and infrastructure in your country? [Recycling]
questions.label: Satisfaction with Recycling

questions.text: Generally speaking, how satisfied are you with the following public services and infrastructure in your country? [Water and sanitation]
questions.label: Satisfaction with Water and Sanitation

questions.text: How far do you agree or disagree with the following statement: My community relies on money or food from exploiting resources such as wildlife, timber, medicinal plants or minerals, to supplement our income
questions.label: Community Reliance on Exploiting Resources
